reason: Batch approval locks the same submitted entries and the caller's own drafts through lockRowsForWrite, so its write names only the locked ids.
Batch revert locks the same approved entries through lockRowsForWrite, so its write names only the locked ids.
Batch mark-non-billable locks the same billable entries through lockRowsForWrite, so its write names only the locked ids.
Batch delete locks the same unbilled entries through lockRowsForWrite, so its delete and write-off name only the locked ids.
